top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises targeted protein degradation as a mature, mechanistically settled chemical principle (event-driven, catalytic removal via induced proximity and ternary-complex formation). Crews and Deshaies founded the PROTAC concept, and Handa identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, which explains an old drug and enabled rational glue design, so the citation covers both the PROTAC and glue strands. P002 recognises the same field but replaces Handa with Ciulli, narrowing the scope to the heterobifunctional strand; I rank it second because it is still sound and P000 would withhold a prize from a clearly worthy discovery.
